description: Defines internal low-level scheduling mechanisms and the SchedulingGuard class used to disable and enable cooperative rescheduling within specific code regions, primarily for synchronization purposes in the Abseil library.

classes.name: SchedulingGuard
classes.description: Provides guard semantics to disable and enable cooperative rescheduling of the calling thread within specific program blocks.

classes.name: SchedulingGuard::ScopedDisable
classes.description: Scoped helper to disable rescheduling within a code block.

classes.name: SchedulingGuard::ScopedEnable
classes.description: Scoped helper to enable rescheduling temporarily.

methods.name: SchedulingGuard::ReschedulingIsAllowed
methods.description: Returns whether the calling thread may be cooperatively rescheduled.

methods.name: SchedulingGuard::DisableRescheduling
methods.description: Disables cooperative rescheduling of the calling thread.

methods.name: SchedulingGuard::ScopedEnable::~ScopedEnable
methods.description: Destructor that checks for proper usage.
